# Coffee AI | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | AI-first sells CRM, which can be used independently, or as an accompanying layer for Salesforce or HubSpot, with a focus on eliminating entry and post-conference administration. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | The ecological scale of new products and regional support is subject to validation; the recording of meetings is subject to the establishment of an informed consent; the reference price of $20 comes from the manufacturer's blog and varies from the official offer. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | New product eco-scale and regional support to be verified; meeting recording to be established informed consent; $20 reference price from vendor blog, not equivalent to a formal quote. |
